statement: Implement Q9 pilot cutover and rollback receipts across the pilot cutover workflow contract, pilot cutover workflow owner, and CLI cutover router so external-system migrations progress through draft/loading/syncing/parity/cutover_pending/cutover/complete/rolled_back/failed with immutable sealed plans, consume Q8 initial load receipts, ingest monotonic idempotent incremental change-feed batches, verify key-range SHA-256 and row parity over external pgwire, gate cutover on passing parity, enumerate post-cutover target writes in rollback divergence receipts, and recover workflow state deterministically from durable SQL receipts across restarts.
